title: Destructure hypotheses with rcases
summary: Unpack nested existential and conjunction hypotheses into named bindings in one line.
code: theorem exists_and_swap (P Q : Nat -> Prop) (h : exists n, P n /\ Q n) : exists n, Q n /\ P n := by
triggers: unpack an existential witness and multiple conjunctions in one pattern
destruct nested structures or sum types in a single tactic
prompts: A hypothesis asserts there exists n such that P n and Q n, and you need to swap the conjuncts.
You want to bind the witness and both proof terms of a sigma/exists hypothesis cleanly.
invariant: rcases recursively applies elimination rules matching the anonymous constructor pattern.
mantra: Unpack nested hypotheses with rcases, repack with exact ⟨...⟩.
pitfalls: Using ⟨a, b⟩ with only two binders when three fields exist leaves a conjunction unsplit.
Forgetting exact before ⟨...⟩ fails because ⟨...⟩ alone is a term, not a tactic.

anchors.name: Recursive pattern match
anchors.trick: Use ⟨n, hp, hq⟩ to flatten nested exists and /\ in one step.

mutations.explanation: Swapping hp and hq is required to match Q n /\ P n.
